````text
# Specification: Booking Lifecycle

- Status: **Approved specification — module plan and implementation acceptance pending**
- Approved: 2026-10-06 by the project owner (approval record: baseline Section 21.9)
- Module ID: `booking-lifecycle` (`SPEC-03`)
- Contract baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.1.0`
- Inherited baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.0.0` (historical contract)
- Accepted amendment: baseline Section 21
- Initial owner role: A (member name to be assigned)
- Team execution contract: [`docs/team-implementation.md`](./docs/team-implementation.md)
- Requirement ownership: ACC-001; TML-001 through TML-008
- Depends on: `identity-access`, `venue-catalog`
- Consumers: `payments-billing`, `invitation-studio`, `guest-rsvp`, `seating-plan`, `staff-operations`, `notifications-automation`, `analytics-dashboard`

## 1. Purpose and non-goals

This module is authoritative for consultations, event-slot availability and holds,
bookings, copied timeline proposals, approvals, deposit eligibility, planning
headcount, cancellation, and completion. It requests restricted workspace access only
after a consultation exists through the identity-owned provider contract.

It does not own passwords, invitation tokens, payment attempts or settlement, catalog
geometry/prices, guest households, seating labels, print fulfilment, or notifications.
It persists exact catalog-version IDs and immutable owned snapshots; it never looks up a
current catalog record to reinterpret a committed proposal or booking.

## 2. Authoritative model and invariants

| Aggregate    | Authoritative facts                                                                     | History rule                                         |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Consultation | manager, intended contact, restricted-workspace link, proposal context                  | Invitation revocation never deletes it.              |
| Slot hold    | hall, local event date, shift, holder, expiry                                           | One active hold per slot; expiry is terminal.        |
| Booking      | consultation, hall/shift/date snapshots, phase, effective timeline, headcount, revision | Saves exact selected catalog versions.               |
| Timeline     | booking-owned ordered items, approvals, predecessor                                     | Every substantive save has a new immutable revision. |

`eventDate` is an ISO local date in `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`; timestamps are UTC. Shift codes
are `LUNCH` and `DINNER`. Phases are `DRAFT`, `AWAITING_DEPOSIT`, `CONFIRMED`,
`CANCELLED`, and `COMPLETED`.

```text
DRAFT -> AWAITING_DEPOSIT -> CONFIRMED -> COMPLETED
| | |
+-------------+-----------------+-> CANCELLED
```

Only a current mutually approved timeline revision permits `AWAITING_DEPOSIT`. After
settlement, the previous effective revision remains valid until an approved replacement
becomes effective. A client redirect or callback body alone never changes booking state.

## 3. Produced backend contracts

```ts
interface BookingLifecycleReader {
  requireBookingAccess(input: {
    bookingId: string;
    accountId: string;
    minimum: 'RESTRICTED' | 'FULL';
  }): Promise<{
    consultationId: string;
    bookingId: string;
    phase: 'DRAFT' | 'AWAITING_DEPOSIT' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'CANCELLED' | 'COMPLETED';
  }>;
  requireDepositEligibility(input: { bookingId: string; timelineRevisionId: string }): Promise<{
    eligible: boolean;
    reasonCode:
      | 'ELIGIBLE'
      | 'TIMELINE_NOT_MUTUALLY_APPROVED'
      | 'REVISION_SUPERSEDED'
      | 'SLOT_NOT_AVAILABLE'
      | 'BOOKING_NOT_PAYABLE';
    consultationId: string;
    coupleAccountId: string;
    bookingRevision: number;
    depositAmountVnd: number;
  }>;
  requireConfirmedEventContext(bookingId: string): Promise<{
    consultationId: string;
    bookingId: string;
    hallId: string;
    shiftCode: 'LUNCH' | 'DINNER';
    eventDate: string;
    effectiveTimelineRevisionId: string;
    planningHeadcount: number;
  }>;
}

interface BookingDepositRecorder {
  recordSuccessfulDeposit(input: {
    bookingId: string;
    timelineRevisionId: string;
    paymentId: string;
    amountVnd: number;
    settledAt: Date;
  }): Promise<{ phase: 'CONFIRMED'; replayed: boolean }>;
}

interface BookingPlanningHeadcountUpdater {
  updateFromGuestPlan(input: {
    bookingId: string;
    sourceRsvpRevisionId: string;
    expectedAttendees: number;
  }): Promise<{ bookingRevision: number; changed: boolean }>;
}
```

`requireDepositEligibility` is a fresh-state check, not a token; payments must repeat
it immediately before money effects. Deposit recording is idempotent by `paymentId`.
Changing the booking, revision, or amount for an existing payment returns
`409 PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT`. RSVP updates are idempotent by source revision and an
older revision cannot restore stale planning data. The ordered update path uses
`BookingPlanningHeadcountSynchronizer` from accepted amendment 1.1.0; UUIDs themselves
are never compared. The original updater remains for serialized legacy callers only.

## 4. Consumed contracts and emitted events

| Provider         | Contract/event                                                                                 | Permitted use                                                             |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| identity-access  | `WorkspaceInvitationIssuer`, `ConsultationAccessReader`, `AccountRetentionEligibilityRecorder` | Issue/revoke access, authorize a consultation, record retention evidence. |
| venue-catalog    | `VenueCatalogReader`                                                                           | Resolve active selections and exact historical versions.                  |
| payments-billing | `billing.payment-succeeded` v1                                                                 | Reconciliation input only; persisted payment evidence remains required.   |

This module emits the baseline `booking.timeline-review-requested`,
`booking.timeline-approved`, `booking.timeline-superseded`, `booking.deposit-eligible`,
`booking.expected-headcount-changed`, `booking.cancelled`, and `booking.completed` v1
events. An outbox saves each fact atomically with its state change. Payloads contain
only the baseline IDs/timestamps/revisions and no contact, token, or live catalog data.

## 5. Authorization and HTTP hand-off

Managers create consultations, availability, holds, bookings, cancellations, and
completion. Restricted prospects read and collaborate only on their consultation
proposal/timeline; full Couple accounts work only on their booking. Staff/public users
have no such mutation. Both Manager and Couple approvals bind to the exact revision.
Editing or superseding does not carry an approval forward.

Specified resources are `/management/consultations`, `/management/availability`,
`/bookings`, and `/bookings/{bookingId}/timeline-revisions`, with explicit action paths
for hold, approval, withdrawal, cancellation, and completion. All external writes use
strict Zod, expected revision, and `Idempotency-Key`. Stable errors include
`STALE_BOOKING_REVISION`, `INVALID_BOOKING_TRANSITION`, `TIMELINE_REVISION_SUPERSEDED`,
and concealed `BOOKING_NOT_FOUND` where existence must not be revealed.

Management Web owns consultation/availability/proposal administration. Web and Android
own their generated-contract views; the restricted workspace exists on Web only.
Android starts after `FULL` access and confirmed deposit. Neither client recalculates eligibility.

## 6. Concurrency, audit, and acceptance

- Database constraints serialize active-slot allocation; concurrent requests yield one
  winner and no partial booking.
- Approval compares exact revision; edit/approval races either preserve a valid old
  approval with a successor or return a stale conflict.
- Settlement compares eligibility/revision while persisting `paymentId`; callbacks may
  duplicate, reorder, or arrive after a client timeout safely.
- Audit creation, hold/release, edits, approvals, withdrawals, deposit recording,
  headcount changes, cancellation, completion, and protected denials with redacted data.

Acceptance proves ACC-001 and TML-001–008, immutable catalog snapshots, restricted/full
denials, slot/approval/deposit races, duplicate events, OpenAPI drift, and real identity
and venue integration. SPEC-02 V4 is accepted; implementation still requires this
module's bounded plan approval and applicable contract-artifact/provider gates.

## 7. Fixed decisions and provider hand-off

These implementation defaults are locked by project-owner SPEC approval on 2026-10-06.
Hold expiry may release a slot only when no unresolved deposit reservation pins it;
an UNKNOWN provider outcome does not become a free slot merely because time elapsed.

| Concern          | Contract                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Slot identity    | Unique hall ID + eventDate + shiftCode; expired holds without unresolved deposit reservations release by database time inside allocation transaction.      |
| Hold             | 15 minutes; only one active hold per slot and one unresolved deposit reservation per booking.                                                              |
| Proposal         | Exact menu version, positive table count 1–500, planning count 0–10,000, hall/shift/menu/policy snapshots.                                                 |
| Commercial total | baseChargeVnd = tableCount × snapshotted menu per-table price; no tax/discount/add-on line in this initial slice. Checked safe-integer arithmetic.         |
| Deposit          | 30% of baseChargeVnd, rounded upward to whole VND; fixed in the commercial/policy revision, never a browser amount.                                        |
| Timeline         | 0–100 items while drafting; approval requires at least one; title 1–120, description 0–2,000; local HH:mm within snapshotted shift.                        |
| Revision         | Per-booking/timeline monotonically increasing safe integer plus immutable UUID; a canonical no-op save returns the same revision.                          |
| Cancellation     | Manager command before event starts with reason 1–500; Couple submits a request for Manager decision. Historical money remains for billing reconciliation. |
| Completion       | Confirmed event's snapshotted end + 12 hours; only Manager or allowlisted completion worker.                                                               |

Additive ports owned here are `BookingTimelineSnapshotReader`,
`BookingPlanningHeadcountSynchronizer`, `BookingDepositIntentCoordinator`,
`BookingAutomationPort`, `BookingCommercialSnapshotReader`, `BookingPlanningSnapshotReader`, and
`BookingReportingReader`, as defined in baseline Section 21. There is no downstream
payment/guest repository read. Payments passes persisted settlement evidence; guest
passes ordered aggregate plan evidence.

The source commercial revision is created when the latest proposal is accepted for
deposit. During a reserved/unresolved deposit attempt, price/slot/timeline edits and
withdrawals that would invalidate it fail with `DEPOSIT_INTENT_ACTIVE`. Real-provider
contract tests serialize eligibility/reservation versus edit, expiry, and settlement.
Exact settled-payment replay is checked before rejecting current phase `CONFIRMED`.

## 8. External command schemas and transitions

All listed schemas are strict; omitted optional properties preserve their prior value.
Output timestamps are ISO UTC strings; integers and UUIDs follow baseline conventions.

| Method/path                                                     | Request data                                                                                     | Result / authority                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| POST /management/consultations                                  | intendedEmail, displayName (1–120), optional note (0–2,000)                                      | 201 consultationId/revision; Manager only; invitation requested by separate command.                                                 |
| POST /management/consultations/{id}/workspace-invitations       | expectedRevision                                                                                 | 202 consultationId/invitation status; identity owns token/email. Failure leaves consultation and retry intent intact.                |
| GET /management/availability                                    | hallId, eventDate, shiftCode                                                                     | Slot availability/expiry only; Manager. Public current-slot availability may be read through a separately authorized proposal query. |
| POST /bookings                                                  | consultationId, hallId, eventDate, shiftCode, menuPackageVersionId, tableCount, expectedRevision | 201 bookingId/revision/safe snapshots; Manager.                                                                                      |
| POST /bookings/{id}/slot-holds                                  | expectedRevision                                                                                 | holdId/expiresAt/revision; Manager only.                                                                                             |
| GET /bookings/{id}/proposal                                     | no body                                                                                          | Safe proposal/timeline/access capabilities; Manager or own restricted/full grant.                                                    |
| POST /bookings/{id}/timeline-revisions                          | expectedRevision, predecessorRevisionId, items[{itemId?, order, startTime, title, description?}] | New exact timeline revision; Manager or own consultation collaborator.                                                               |
| POST /bookings/{id}/timeline-revisions/{revisionId}/approvals   | expectedRevision                                                                                 | Approval party is derived from actor; no submitted party/role; exact current revision only.                                          |
| POST /bookings/{id}/timeline-revisions/{revisionId}/withdrawals | expectedRevision, reason                                                                         | Pre-deposit own-party approval withdrawal; never withdraw effective post-deposit history.                                            |
| POST /bookings/{id}/change-requests                             | expectedRevision, replacement items, reason                                                      | Proposed post-deposit revision; previous effective content remains.                                                                  |
| POST /bookings/{id}/cancellation-requests                       | expectedRevision, reason                                                                         | Couple request only; does not cancel booking or refund.                                                                              |
| POST /management/bookings/{id}/cancellation                     | expectedRevision, reason                                                                         | Manager cancellation and audit; refuses active unresolved deposit reservation.                                                       |
| POST /management/bookings/{id}/completion                       | expectedRevision                                                                                 | Manager invokes same guarded completion domain command as automation.                                                                |

Moving to a successor before deposit resets both approval flags for that successor and
removes deposit eligibility even if an older revision was mutually approved. Booking
returns to proposal work until current mutual approval is restored. Post-deposit change
approval is separate: both parties must approve the same replacement, then an atomic
effective-pointer switch emits supersession. An approved revision is never edited.

## 9. Failures, events, and concurrency proof

| Failure                                               | Status | Observable result                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SLOT_NOT_AVAILABLE / SLOT_HOLD_EXPIRED                | 409    | No allocation/revival; safe availability refresh.                                      |
| STALE_BOOKING_REVISION / TIMELINE_REVISION_SUPERSEDED | 409    | Current revision IDs only to an authorized caller.                                     |
| DEPOSIT_INTENT_ACTIVE                                 | 409    | Request cannot invalidate active/unknown payment intent.                               |
| HEADCOUNT_SOURCE_CONFLICT                             | 409    | Same sequence with different immutable evidence rejected.                              |
| TIMELINE_NOT_MUTUALLY_APPROVED / BOOKING_NOT_PAYABLE  | 409    | Eligibility reason, no payment effect.                                                 |
| BOOKING_NOT_FOUND                                     | 404    | Conceal unowned consultation/booking.                                                  |
| PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE                                  | 503    | Command rolls back or records a retryable invitation intent; no partial access claims. |

Produced/consumed event names and minimum payloads are Section 4 and baseline Section 7.
Outbox insertion, state revision, audit, and reporting source sequence commit together.
Invitation-issuance reconciliation is keyed by consultation/request intent, not retry time.
A failed email does not create a duplicate consultation/account.

## 10. Parallel implementation matrix and proposed waves

| Slice                                         | Can implement against fakes                 | Real dependency / shared lane                                        |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Slot/timeline/commercial rules and unit tests | Yes after contract/plan approval            | SPEC-02 V4 remains the start gate; persistence migration serialized. |
| Consultation/access/venue adapters            | Provider contracts already exist            | Real identity/venue before provider checkpoint.                      |
| Headcount/deposit/timeline/automation ports   | Own domain and conforming evidence fixtures | Shared booking serialization and outbox lane before PROVIDER_READY.  |
| Manager/Couple Web components                 | Local read-model fixtures                   | Network integration waits committed OpenAPI digest.                  |
| Booking acceptance                            | No                                          | Real identity/venue, PostgreSQL slot/edit/settlement races.          |

Proposed waves (maximum eight): consultation/proposal; slot persistence/holds;
timeline revision/approvals; deposit reservation/provider boundary; changes/cancellation/
completion; HTTP/OpenAPI; independent client adapters/screens; acceptance. Each wave
is sliced into at most five human-authored files per task and is planned after SPEC approval.

| Requirement      | Required focused evidence                                                                        |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| ACC-001          | Consultation survives issue failure; retry creates one restricted invitation via real identity.  |
| TML-001/002      | Template-copy/empty draft, order/time/text bounds, CRUD and reorder.                             |
| TML-003/004      | No-op save, immutable predecessor, exact two-party approvals, stale edit race.                   |
| TML-005/006      | Current revision only; reserve/withdraw/edit race; server deposit amount.                        |
| TML-007/008      | Effective content retained, mutually approved replacement, immutable audit history.              |
| Shared contracts | Headcount sequence 10 then 9; duplicate settlement; due completion replays; report-page rebuild. |
````

````text
# Specification: Payments and Billing

- Status: **Approved specification — module plan and implementation acceptance pending**
- Approved: 2026-10-06 by the project owner (approval record: baseline Section 21.9)
- Module ID: `payments-billing` (`SPEC-04`)
- Contract baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.1.0`
- Inherited baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.0.0` (historical contract)
- Accepted amendment: baseline Section 21
- Initial owner role: A (member name to be assigned)
- Team execution contract: [`docs/team-implementation.md`](./docs/team-implementation.md)
- Requirement ownership: PRN-006
- Depends on: `booking-lifecycle`
- Consumers: `invitation-studio`, `notifications-automation`, `analytics-dashboard`

## 1. Purpose and ownership

This module owns payment intents/attempts, VNPay sandbox verification, manual payment
evidence, settlement, invoices, receivable charges, refunds, reconciliation, and all
authoritative money totals. Amounts are integer VND in APIs and `Decimal(18,0)` in
PostgreSQL. Payment, refund, and charge facts are immutable; corrections are new facts.

It does not calculate booking eligibility, alter booking phases directly, promote
access directly, own print quotation content, or accept a client amount as authority.

## 2. Financial model and state contract

| Record            | Owner-controlled fact                                                | Required invariant                                        |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Payment attempt   | purpose, amount snapshot, provider/manual evidence, processing state | Persist intent before provider interaction.               |
| Payment           | proven settlement                                                    | One immutable `paymentId`; callbacks cannot duplicate it. |
| Receivable charge | accepted source revision and amount                                  | Unique `(sourceType, sourceRevisionId)` for print.        |
| Refund            | source payment, amount, reason, evidence                             | Never exceeds available settled amount.                   |
| Invoice view      | charges, paid, refunded, outstanding                                 | Derived from ledger only, never client totals.            |

A deposit uses `requireDepositEligibility` immediately before creation and settlement;
the amount is returned `depositAmountVnd`. A provider timeout is `UNKNOWN` until
reconciliation proves an outcome and never authorizes a second charge.

## 3. Produced contracts

```ts
interface BillingReader {
  requireDepositSettlement(bookingId: string): Promise<{
    paymentId: string;
    amountVnd: number;
    settledAt: Date;
  }>;
  getBookingReceivables(bookingId: string): Promise<{
    acceptedChargesVnd: number;
    paidVnd: number;
    refundedVnd: number;
    outstandingVnd: number;
  }>;
}

interface BookingChargeRegistrar {
  registerAcceptedCharge(input: {
    bookingId: string;
    sourceType: 'PRINT_ORDER';
    sourceRevisionId: string;
    amountVnd: number;
    acceptedAt: Date;
  }): Promise<{ receivableChargeId: string; replayed: boolean }>;
}
```

The registrar atomically claims the source revision. Identical replay returns
`replayed: true`; changed booking/amount/date is `409 RECEIVABLE_SOURCE_CONFLICT`.
Readers disclose only minimum data for an already-authorized booking.

## 4. Consumed contracts and emitted events

| Provider          | Contract                                           | Boundary rule                                                   |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| booking-lifecycle | `BookingLifecycleReader`, `BookingDepositRecorder` | Recheck before money effect; record only proven settlement.     |
| identity-access   | `CoupleAccessPromoter`                             | Promote same account using successful deposit `paymentId`.      |
| invitation-studio | none before charge                                 | It invokes this module only after freezing commercial revision. |

The module emits `billing.payment-succeeded`, `billing.receivable-charge-accepted`, and
`billing.refund-recorded` v1. The ledger row and event outbox are transactional; each
payload conforms to the baseline minimum and excludes credentials/callback bodies.

## 5. Authorization and HTTP contract

Couple users start an eligible deposit and read their booking's safe billing view.
Managers record approved manual evidence, reconcile, and refund. An authenticated
restricted prospect may create a deposit intent for their own consultation only when
current eligibility passes; `COUPLE` role or `FULL` access is not required for that
specific action. Staff and public/guest links cannot mutate billing. VNPay callback input is
untrusted until signature and existing-attempt correlation are verified.

Specified routes are `/bookings/{bookingId}/payments/deposit`, `/billing/callbacks/vnpay`,
`/management/billing/payments/manual`, `/management/billing/refunds`, and
`/bookings/{bookingId}/billing`. Money commands require `Idempotency-Key`; callbacks
deduplicate by provider transaction identity and canonical payload hash. Stable errors:
`DEPOSIT_NOT_ELIGIBLE`, `PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT`, `PAYMENT_CALLBACK_INVALID`,
`PAYMENT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, and `RECEIVABLE_SOURCE_CONFLICT`.

## 6. Failure, audit, and acceptance

- Intent claim, callback decision, settlement, booking confirmation, access promotion,
  and outbox effects are recoverable and reconciled without duplicate charges.
- In-flight duplicates return `409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`; changed-body key
  reuse is `422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.
- Refund recording locks/rechecks available balance; it never changes historical payment
  or demotes Couple access.
- Audit initiation, verification decision, settlement, manual evidence, reconciliation,
  charge, invoice, and refund without secrets, bank/card data, or raw callback payloads.

Acceptance proves callback duplication/reordering, timeout reconciliation,
eligibility-supersession race, one accepted print charge, refund race, booking/identity
integration, immutable receivable totals, PRN-006 reporting, and OpenAPI drift.

## 7. Accounting decisions and additive ports

| Value              | Exact definition                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| acceptedChargesVnd | Sum of immutable accepted base-booking and print charges minus accepted credit adjustments. Never negative.      |
| paidVnd            | Sum of proven positive settled payments, including deposit and balance. Failed/pending attempts contribute zero. |
| refundedVnd        | Sum of recorded completed manual refunds; pending refund intent contributes zero.                                |
| netPaidVnd         | paidVnd − refundedVnd.                                                                                           |
| outstandingVnd     | max(acceptedChargesVnd − netPaidVnd, 0).                                                                         |
| creditVnd          | max(netPaidVnd − acceptedChargesVnd, 0); visible for Manager reconciliation, never an automatic refund.          |

Booking owns the accepted immutable commercial snapshot. Before confirming settlement,
billing records the base charge once by that commercial revision through its own internal
ledger operation; booking base amount is not duplicated as both a base charge and a
deposit charge. Deposit is payment toward the base charge. Remaining-balance payments
reduce the same outstanding amount. Print charge registration uses the unchanged
`BookingChargeRegistrar`; cancellation/replacement credits use additive
`BookingChargeAdjustmentRegistrar` (baseline Section 21). Credit and charge records
are append-only, idempotent by immutable source, and linked to their original evidence.

Refund amount must be positive, no greater than unrefunded source settlement, and no
greater than the approved refundable amount under the recorded cancellation/credit
decision. Manager explicitly supplies reason/evidence; system does not automatically
refund or demote access. Initial refund interface is manual only. Billing owns
`BillingReportingReader` and publishes the readonly row/schema described in Section 21.

Attempt states: `CREATED -> PENDING -> SUCCEEDED | FAILED | UNKNOWN`;
`UNKNOWN` changes only from proven evidence/reconciliation. `SUCCEEDED` is terminal;
duplicates cannot change it. Callback with a different amount/currency/booking or a reused
provider transaction for another attempt is quarantined as evidence conflict.

## 8. Deposit orchestration and verified callback contract

1. Authorize current restricted/full access to the own booking. Require exact requested
   timeline revision; derive amount from booking, never request body.
2. Atomically claim one durable idempotent attempt and reserve booking through
   `BookingDepositIntentCoordinator.reserve`. Missing reservation rolls back attempt
   creation; the provider checkout URL is not exposed before commit.
3. Persist checkout intent before provider call. Initial intent expiry is 15 minutes.
   Distinct client keys cannot open multiple unresolved deposit intents for one booking.
4. Verify callback signature and correlate merchant order/transaction ID, VND amount,
   currency, and current persisted attempt. Persist success/failure evidence once.
5. Apply base charge, payment, booking deposit recorder, and identity promotion with a
   shared application transaction or durable recoverable application state. HTTP reports
   application pending until booking and promotion both succeed.
6. Unknown outcomes hold reservation and reconcile; only verified terminal failure may
   release it. Exact successful payment replay bypasses fresh-payability rejection.
   Late money received is retained in ledger even when Manager reconciliation is needed.

The owning adapter must specify sandbox merchant configuration, canonical signing input,
verification, status query, and callback response codes from official VNPay integration
documentation during adapter implementation. Signatures are verified over provider-defined
canonical data before trusting normalized values; HTTP redirect success is never evidence.
No guessed signing algorithm/field mapping is allowed. Keys/merchant secrets are backend
environment inputs. Contract-ready provider tests include official sandbox fixtures.

## 9. HTTP schema hand-off and races

| Method/path                              | Strict request / response                                                       | Authorized actor                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| POST /bookings/{id}/payments/deposit     | timelineRevisionId; result paymentAttemptId/status/checkoutUrl/expiresAt        | Own restricted/full access; no amount or role accepted.                                                |
| GET /bookings/{id}/payments/{attemptId}  | Safe status, amountVnd, purpose, downstream application status                  | Own restricted/full booking grant or Manager.                                                          |
| POST /bookings/{id}/payments/balance     | expectedBillingRevision; server full outstanding amount                         | Own FULL account or Manager.                                                                           |
| POST /management/billing/payments/manual | bookingId, purpose, amountVnd, settledAt, evidenceReference (1–120), reason     | Manager; deposit still requires eligibility/reservation; balance cannot exceed authorized outstanding. |
| POST /management/billing/refunds         | sourcePaymentId, amountVnd, expectedBillingRevision, reason, evidenceReference  | Manager; refundable limit checked transactionally.                                                     |
| GET /bookings/{id}/billing               | Totals above, payment/charge/refund history with pagination and billingRevision | FULL own booking or Manager; restricted actor sees deposit status only.                                |
| GET /billing/callbacks/vnpay             | Provider-defined IPN query; provider-required acknowledgement                   | Signature/correlation, not user role; authoritative GET IPN as specified below.                        |

Callbacks use provider-specific verification/deduplication rather than a client
`Idempotency-Key` requirement. Client/server mutations use the platform durable key.
Balance initiation serializes against another in-flight balance/manual payment to prevent
concurrent collection of the same outstanding amount. Every true settlement is recorded;
a late duplicate business payment becomes explicit credit/reconciliation, not data loss.

Credit-adjustment conflicts use `RECEIVABLE_ADJUSTMENT_CONFLICT` (409); source money
mismatch uses `PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT` (409); invalid signatures use
`PAYMENT_CALLBACK_INVALID` (400); reconciliation reads return status `UNKNOWN`
instead of pretending a timeout means failure. Private unowned reads use concealed 404.

## 10. Parallel implementation and acceptance matrix

| Slice                                        | Allowed overlap                                                             | Required real readiness                                    |
| -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| Payment/refund pure rules, ledger port tests | Booking implementation and client work                                      | Reviewed amount/eligibility/accounting DTOs.               |
| VNPay adapter/parser/status polling          | Own domain and booking fakes                                                | Sandbox fixtures/config before real provider checkpoint.   |
| Ledger persistence/manual refund             | Different module files                                                      | Serialized migration lane; real PostgreSQL locking.        |
| Deposit integration/promotion                | May begin when specific Booking ports are ready, before all Booking screens | Real reservation/recorder/identity; mocks cannot close it. |
| Billing Web/App presentation                 | Local fixtures, then digest-based generated client                          | Real billing API for end-to-end acceptance.                |

Proposed waves: ledger and accounting; reservation/deposit; verified callback/reconciliation;
manual payments/refunds/credit adjustments; billing/invoice HTTP/OpenAPI; independent
clients; acceptance (seven). Immutable invoice has an invoice number, issuedAt, source
ledger revision, integer totals and line sources; issuing it does not collect money.

| Requirement/contract | Required evidence                                                                                                    |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PRN-006              | Exact print commercial source registers once; appears in billing/invoice.                                            |
| Deposit promotion    | Restricted actor succeeds only when eligible; edit race denied; same account becomes FULL.                           |
| Accounting           | Base plus print, deposit plus balance, cancellation credit and manual refund produce exact totals.                   |
| Retry/evidence       | Same and different-body keys, reordered callback, unknown timeout, crash between settlement/confirmation/promotion.  |
| Concurrency          | Two refunds cannot exceed source; two balance intents cannot collect same outstanding; real provider contract tests. |

## 11. Verified VNPay sandbox mapping

Use API 2.1.0 with `vnp_Command=pay`, `vnp_CurrCode=VND`,
`vnp_TxnRef=paymentAttemptId`, and `vnp_Amount=amountVnd*100`.
Create/expiry dates use yyyyMMddHHmmss in GMT+7. Sandbox checkout is
`https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html`.
Canonical checksum sorts parameter names; use HMAC-SHA512 and the official
parameter encoding. Exclude `vnp_SecureHash`/`vnp_SecureHashType` from verification.
Reject duplicated query keys rather than ambiguous parsing. Verified success requires
both response code and transaction status `00`; IPN is authoritative, ReturnURL is display.

IPN acknowledgement is HTTP 200 JSON `{RspCode, Message}`: 00 processed, 02 already
processed, 01 unknown order, 04 amount mismatch, 97 invalid signature, 99 processing
failure. Acknowledgement means durable evidence was recorded; downstream application
may reconcile separately. This provider-specific body is an explicit exception to the
normal application error envelope.

Source: [official VNPay PAY integration documentation](https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/apis/docs/thanh-toan-pay/pay.html),
checked 2026-10-06. Adapter tests include encoding/amount/signature/IPN duplicate fixtures
and keep credentials/configuration out of source.
````

````text
# Specification: Invitation Studio

- Status: **Approved specification — module plan and implementation acceptance pending**
- Approved: 2026-10-06 by the project owner (approval record: baseline Section 21.9)
- Module ID: `invitation-studio` (`SPEC-05`)
- Contract baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.1.0`
- Inherited baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.0.0` (historical contract)
- Accepted amendment: baseline Section 21
- Initial owner role: B (member name to be assigned)
- W1 backend status: **Implementation and verification complete**, 2026-10-09; checklist and limits in Section11. W2–W4 backend/API checkpoints are recorded in Sections13–14; formal integration and whole-module acceptance remain pending.
- Media HTTP status: **Mounted at `/api/v1`**, 2026-10-09, after the user's subsequent API wiring request; transport scope in Section12. Other W6 work remains pending.
- Team execution contract: [`docs/team-implementation.md`](./docs/team-implementation.md)
- Requirement ownership: MED-001 through MED-006; PRN-001 through PRN-005 and PRN-007 through PRN-009; QRC-001 through QRC-004
- Depends on: `core-platform`, `identity-access`, `venue-catalog` (accepted 1.1.0 eligibility read), `booking-lifecycle`, `payments-billing`
- Consumers: `guest-rsvp`, `seating-plan`, `notifications-automation`, `analytics-dashboard`

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

This module owns post-deposit private wedding media, invitation designs/revisions,
generic public invitations, printable snapshots, print orders/lines/quotes, and print
fulfilment. It provides a full Couple Web editor and a constrained Couple App
quick-edit/preview/share surface. It does not own payment truth, guest/RSVP data,
catalog geometry, or a live seating repository.

Private media requires current `FULL` access and a confirmed booking. Private original Storage keys and
signed library URLs never reach public output. A generic public slug is opaque and unguessable,
but is never RSVP, check-in, or identity authority and returns only published content.

## 2. Immutable revision and print state contract

Design edits create immutable `invitationDesignRevisionId`s. Publishing captures one
immutable public revision. A printable revision freezes design, effective timeline,
optional eligible seating snapshot, public-invitation reference, and content digest.

```text
REQUESTED -> QUOTED -> APPROVED -> IN_PRODUCTION -> READY_FOR_HANDOVER -> HANDED_OVER
| | |
+----------+----------+----------------------------------------------> CANCELLED
```

Manager re-quotation creates a new commercial revision. Couple approval names the exact
current revision. No transition skips quote, Couple approval, or printable/commercial
capture; deadline details await this SPEC's decision approval.

## 3. Produced backend contracts

```ts
interface InvitationPublicationReader {
  requirePublishedPublicInvitation(bookingId: string): Promise<{
    publicInvitationId: string;
    publicSlug: string;
    publishedRevisionId: string;
  }>;
  resolvePrintableRevision(printableRevisionId: string): Promise<{
    bookingId: string;
    designRevisionId: string;
    timelineRevisionId: string;
    seatingPlanRevisionId: string | null;
    publicInvitationId: string;
    contentDigest: string;
  }>;
}

interface PrintableSeatingContentRegistry {
  registerConfirmed(input: {
    bookingId: string;
    seatingPlanRevisionId: string;
    seatingPlanRevisionNumber: number;
    layoutTemplateVersionId: string;
    contentDigest: string;
    validityProof?: PrintableSeatingValidityProof;
    renderSnapshot: readonly {
      layoutTableId: string;
      tableLabel: string;
      shape: 'ROUND' | 'RECTANGLE';
      x: number;
      y: number;
      width: number;
      height: number;
      rotationDegrees: number;
      guestGroupId: string | null;
      guestGroupName: string | null;
      color: string | null;
    }[];
  }): Promise<{ registered: true; replayed: boolean }>;
  markRequiresReview(input: {
    bookingId: string;
    seatingPlanRevisionId: string;
    seatingPlanRevisionNumber: number;
    reasonCode: 'HEADCOUNT_OUTSIDE_LAYOUT_RANGE' | 'LAYOUT_RETIRED';
  }): Promise<{ invalidated: true; replayed: boolean }>;
}
```

Registration is idempotent by revision/digest. Invalidation is terminal for that same
revision number; delayed registration cannot restore eligibility. Reconfirmation creates
a new immutable revision with a higher number. Changed digest is
`409 PRINTABLE_SEATING_DIGEST_CONFLICT`. Higher revision wins; delayed calls cannot
re-enable older content. Seating designs require the highest eligible registered
snapshot; non-seating designs explicitly store `seatingPlanRevisionId: null`.

## 4. Consumed contracts and emitted events

| Provider          | Contract                                  | Use                                                        |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| identity-access   | actor/access resolution                   | Require current `FULL` Couple access.                      |
| booking-lifecycle | confirmed event/access readers            | Confirm deposit and snapshot event/timeline context.       |
| payments-billing  | `BookingChargeRegistrar`, `BillingReader` | Register frozen charge; never compute receivables locally. |
| core-platform     | private storage and AI-image boundary     | Validate assets and isolate generated content.             |

It emits `invitation.publication-changed`, `invitation.print-quotation-issued`,
`invitation.print-order-approved`, and `invitation.print-order-ready` v1. Approval
includes the returned immutable `receivableChargeId` and is emitted only after charge
registration or durable reconciliation prevents duplicate registration.

## 5. Authorization and HTTP contract

Managers manage template library, quote/fulfilment, and authorized media operations.
Full Couple users manage only their confirmed booking's media/designs, print requests,
and current-quote approval. Restricted prospects, Staff, public viewers, and QR holders
cannot read private assets or mutate invitation/print records.

Specified resources are `/bookings/{bookingId}/media`, `/bookings/{bookingId}/invitations`,
`/public/invitations/{publicSlug}`, `/bookings/{bookingId}/print-orders`, and Manager
quote/fulfilment actions. External writes require strict schemas, expected revision, and
`Idempotency-Key`. Public outputs omit private library media IDs/URLs, guest data, operations, billing,
and audit data.

## 6. Race, safety, and acceptance

- Upload verifies allowlisted type/content/size/dimensions, generates private keys, and
  keeps prior content if replacement fails.
- Publish/edit and requote/approval compare exact revisions; one winner means no mixed
  printable or commercial snapshot.
- Approval atomically freezes all lines then registers the charge; retry replays or
  reconciles the recorded pending effect.
- Audit publication, media lifecycle, generation, quote, approval, production,
  handover, cancellation, and denied private access with redacted metadata.

Acceptance covers MED/PRN/QRC, QR isolation, private-media isolation, printable
immutability, charge idempotency, seating-snapshot order, and real booking/billing
integration before completion.

## 7. Media, design, and publication decisions

| Concern         | Approved fixed contract                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Media           | JPEG/PNG/WebP only, verified content, at most 25 MiB/file, 1–12,000 pixels per dimension, at most 40 million decoded pixels.                                        |
| Quota           | 100 active original files and 1 GiB active accepted bytes per booking, serialized quota claim.                                                                      |
| Cutoff          | Event start − 72 hours by default; Manager-defined instant is snapshotted as policyRevision before upload. Couple create/replace/delete blocked at or after cutoff. |
| Restaurant use  | Manager can read/download accepted originals after cutoff for agreed use; changing cutoff is explicit audited policy command, not an upload bypass.                 |
| Asset deletion  | Detach/tombstone from mutable library before cutoff; referenced printable/published revisions keep immutable content. No automatic destructive cleanup here.        |
| AI generation   | Prompt text 1–2,000, one image per request, validated private output; no private wedding photo sent to AI under this scope.                                         |
| Design          | Structured allowlisted sections/fields only; no arbitrary script/HTML/SVG/remote URL; text fields 0–2,000 and title 1–120.                                          |
| Public identity | One stable opaque publicInvitationId/slug per booking; all physical variants use the same generic QR.                                                               |
| Publication     | Explicit full-access Couple publication or authorized Manager action; unpublish returns concealed 404 to public reads. Historical printable content remains.        |

Original library keys/URLs are never public. An explicitly selected design image is
published as a separate derived asset with a reviewed safe URL; public response never
exposes the private original/library reference. Rendering must escape text and enforce
asset ownership; a design revision cannot refer to another booking's asset. Published
responses omit recipient names, guest groups, operational notes, and internal audit data.

Design DTO includes `designId, revisionId, revisionNumber, title, textFields, sections,
derivedAssetIds, includesSeating, updatedAt`. Quick App edits accept textFields only
and create a new immutable revision through the same backend command. Public DTO contains
only published titles/text, public event/hall information, approved timeline presentation,
and safe derived assets; it offers no guest RSVP/check-in mutation.

## 8. Print quotation, approval, replacement, and cancellation

| Command                         | Actor / source state                                       | Result and constraint                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Request                         | Own FULL Couple / confirmed booking                        | REQUESTED with 1–20 lines; each design variant belongs to booking, quantity 1–10,000.                               |
| Quote/requote before approval   | Manager / REQUESTED or QUOTED                              | New immutable commercial revision; QUOTED; expiry seven days after quote.                                           |
| Approve                         | Own FULL Couple / QUOTED                                   | Exact quote/revision and non-expired deadline; all printable snapshots plus charge accepted; APPROVED.              |
| Begin production                | Manager / APPROVED                                         | IN_PRODUCTION only after all financial/snapshot reconciliation is complete.                                         |
| Ready                           | Manager / IN_PRODUCTION                                    | READY_FOR_HANDOVER with timestamp.                                                                                  |
| Handover                        | Manager / READY_FOR_HANDOVER                               | HANDED_OVER with evidenceReference 1–120 and timestamp.                                                             |
| Cancel request/quote            | Couple own order or Manager / REQUESTED or QUOTED          | CANCELLED; no charge exists.                                                                                        |
| Cancel approved                 | Manager / APPROVED, before production                      | Couple-confirmed cancellation intent, reason and credit adjustment; CANCELLED only after billing credit acceptance. |
| Requote after approval          | Manager + new Couple approval / APPROVED before production | Separate replacement proposal; old accepted revision remains effective until atomic replacement.                    |
| Correct after production starts | New order and explicit new quote/approval                  | Prior produced/handed-over history never changes; cost is visible as a separate order.                              |

A quoted line stores `lineId, designRevisionId, quantity, unitPriceVnd, lineTotalVnd`.
Unit price is positive integer VND up to 1,000,000 per copy. Server calculates
`lineTotalVnd = quantity × unitPriceVnd` and `orderTotalVnd = sum(lineTotalVnd)`;
checked arithmetic and total bound 1,000,000,000,000. Quote stores estimated completion/
handover instant and `expiresAt`; both must be after quote time. No recipient name or
per-recipient token can enter line input, printable DTO, QR data, or render output.

Approval snapshots each line's latest exact approved design choice, effective timeline
through `BookingTimelineSnapshotReader`, highest eligible registered seating content
when included, generic public identity, and commercial revision. Same shared application
transaction serializes timeline effective-pointer changes, seating invalidation, and
quote approval. If any required provider fails, no partial APPROVED state/charge is
visible. Retry uses the same commercial source and snapshot digest.

Replacement accepts a new full charge and a credit for the previous accepted charge
through `BookingChargeAdjustmentRegistrar`; both are atomic or durably pending with
production blocked. Cancellation similarly credits the original charge once. Excess
paid money is visible billing credit; manual refund remains Manager/billing-owned.
Prior printable and commercial records remain immutable after replacement/cancellation.

## 9. Typed HTTP hand-off and stable errors

| Method/path                                                           | Strict input                                                                          | Result                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| POST /bookings/{id}/media                                             | File upload, altText 1–250; no object key                                             | mediaAssetId/revision/safe authorized preview.                                |
| PATCH /bookings/{id}/media/{assetId}                                  | expectedRevision, approved metadata or replacement file                               | New active file version, previous referenced content retained.                |
| DELETE /bookings/{id}/media/{assetId}                                 | expectedRevision                                                                      | Tombstone/detach; before cutoff; durable mutation key.                        |
| POST /bookings/{id}/invitations                                       | design template ID or approved structured content                                     | Design/revision DTO.                                                          |
| POST /bookings/{id}/invitations/{designId}/revisions                  | expectedRevision, textFields/allowlisted sections/assets                              | New immutable revision; App limited to textFields.                            |
| POST /bookings/{id}/invitations/{designId}/publication                | expectedRevision, designRevisionId                                                    | Stable public identity and publishedRevisionId.                               |
| GET /public/invitations/{slug}                                        | Slug only                                                                             | Minimal public DTO, concealed 404 when absent/unpublished.                    |
| POST /bookings/{id}/print-orders                                      | lines[{designId, quantity}]                                                           | REQUESTED DTO/revision, no submitted price.                                   |
| POST /management/print-orders/{orderId}/quotations                    | expectedRevision, prices by line ID, estimatedHandoverAt                              | QUOTED DTO/commercialRevisionId/total/expiresAt.                              |
| POST /bookings/{id}/print-orders/{orderId}/approval                   | expectedRevision, commercialRevisionId                                                | Accepted printable IDs/charge/status.                                         |
| POST /management/print-orders/{orderId}/production, /ready, /handover | expectedRevision; handover evidence when applicable                                   | Allowed state/time/revision only.                                             |
| POST cancellation/replacement action                                  | expectedRevision, exact commercial reference, reason and required Couple confirmation | Audited terminal/replacement result; pending when reconciliations incomplete. |

Errors include `MEDIA_CUTOFF_REACHED`, `MEDIA_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`,
`PRINT_QUOTE_EXPIRED`, `PRINT_QUOTE_STALE`, `PRINTABLE_TIMELINE_NOT_EFFECTIVE`,
`PRINTABLE_SEATING_REQUIRES_REVIEW`, `PRINT_CANCELLATION_NOT_ALLOWED` (409),
upload/schema errors (422), unowned resources (concealed 404), and mandatory provider
unavailable (503). List reads use bounded cursor pages. `InvitationAutomationReader`
and `InvitationReportingReader` are the additive owner ports from baseline Section 21.

## 10. Independent slices and requirement evidence

| Slice                                      | May overlap                                  | Real integration requirement                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Media validation/quota, AI adapter doubles | Payment/booking implementation               | Real confirmed-booking/access and Storage adapter contract.                    |
| Design/editor/public DTO                   | Billing and guest development                | Implemented committed public API before client network integration.            |
| Registry/equal-revision precedence         | Seating pure rules via shared fixtures       | Application unit-of-work and same-booking rollback/race tests.                 |
| Print arithmetic/lifecycle/replacement     | Billing ledger via conforming registrar fake | Actual billing charge/credit and approved timeline snapshot before production. |
| Print acceptance                           | No fake-only closure                         | PostgreSQL quote/edit/invalidation races + real providers.                     |

Proposed waves: media gate/storage/quota; structured design and templates/AI;
publication/public QR; printable registry/snapshot boundary; quote/approval/credit;
HTTP/OpenAPI; Web/App/Manager slices; acceptance (eight).

| Requirements         | Focused proof                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| MED-001–006          | Restricted/other-booking denial, validated upload, cutoff boundary, quota race, originals download, explicit derived publication. |
| PRN-001–003          | Multi-variant quantities, quote totals/expiry/handover; server rejects submitted totals.                                          |
| PRN-004/005          | Snapshot digest stays identical after design/timeline/seating changes; same-revision invalidation wins both orders.               |

| PRN-008; QRC-001–004 | Render has no recipient name and all variants share one generic QR; public cannot RSVP/check-in.                                  |

New seating registrations include the optional 1.1.0 `validityProof` field.
Print approval rechecks current booking headcount/revision and venue active eligibility
through the additive upstream ports in baseline Section 21.10, under the booking unit-of-work.
A pending invalidation event cannot make an out-of-range snapshot valid for printing.
Venue eligibility reads hold the lifecycle shared lock until snapshot approval commits;
a concurrent retirement cannot slip between checking eligibility and accepting the charge.
The accepted venue eligibility dependency is explicit; no live seating read is introduced.
````

````text
# Specification: Guest RSVP

- Status: **Approved specification — module plan and implementation acceptance pending**
- Approved: 2026-10-06 by the project owner (approval record: baseline Section 21.9)
- Module ID: `guest-rsvp` (`SPEC-06`)
- Contract baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.1.0`
- Inherited baseline: `WEDDING-CONTRACT-1@1.0.0` (historical contract)
- Accepted amendment: baseline Section 21
- Initial owner role: B (member name to be assigned)
- Team execution contract: [`docs/team-implementation.md`](./docs/team-implementation.md)
- Requirement ownership: GST-001 through GST-008; QRC-005
- Depends on: `booking-lifecycle`, `invitation-studio`
- Consumers: `seating-plan`, `staff-operations`, `notifications-automation`, `analytics-dashboard`

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

This module owns invitation households/parties, default and custom guest groups,
personalized invitation links, RSVP revisions, and expected-attendance totals. One
record represents one household or party, not an individual attendee; companion names
are deliberately not required. Personalized credentials are separate from the generic
public invitation and grant only their documented RSVP scope.

It does not assign a household/person to a table or seat, decide booking state, own
public generic content, send notification delivery, or record actual arrivals.

## 2. Authoritative data, lifecycle, and privacy

A group has a stable `guestGroupId`, normalized unique name within a booking, color,
and `ACTIVE | ARCHIVED` status. Each new booking gets `Parents`, `Groom Side`,
`Bride Side`, and `Friends` with localized labels. Group IDs—not names or colors—are
referenced by household, seating, staff guidance, and analytics. A referenced group is
archived/renamed without changing historical identity.

A household stores representative name, optional disambiguating phone, group ID,
positive expected count, optional operational note, and immutable RSVP revision history.
A household/personally linked guest sees only link-authorized data; public generic
invitation outputs never include households, phone, notes, groups, or links.

## 3. Produced backend contract

```ts
interface GuestPlanningReader {
  listGuestGroups(bookingId: string): Promise<
    readonly {
      guestGroupId: string;
      name: string;
      color: string;
      status: 'ACTIVE' | 'ARCHIVED';
    }[]
  >;
  requireHouseholdForOperations(invitationHouseholdId: string): Promise<{
    bookingId: string;
    invitationHouseholdId: string;
    guestGroupId: string;
    representativeName: string;
    disambiguatingPhone: string | null;
    expectedAttendees: number;
    operationalNote: string | null;
  }>;
  getExpectedAttendance(bookingId: string): Promise<{
    sourceRsvpRevisionId: string;
    expectedAttendees: number;
  }>;
}
```

Operational reads require caller assignment/authorization and return the minimum listed
fields. Every changed RSVP creates an immutable `rsvpRevisionId`; the latest aggregate
total is reported through accepted `BookingPlanningHeadcountSynchronizer`, never by
writing booking records. The original updater is retained only for serialized legacy use.

## 4. Dependencies and event contract

| Provider          | Contract                                                                | Use                                                                               |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| booking-lifecycle | confirmed booking/access reader, `BookingPlanningHeadcountSynchronizer` | Enforce full/deposit gate and report the ordered aggregate expected total.        |
| invitation-studio | `InvitationPublicationReader`                                           | Link a personalized delivery to a published generic invitation without owning it. |
| identity-access   | actor resolution                                                        | Authorize Couple/Manager actions only; personalized guest links are separate.     |

This module emits `guest.rsvp-updated` and `guest.expected-attendance-changed` v1
with baseline payloads. The household revision and event outbox are atomic. Consumers
deduplicate by event ID and compare sourceSequence, not UUID order, so an older event
cannot restore a previous total. Legacy events trigger an authoritative aggregate read.

## 5. Authorization, HTTP, and failure contract

Managers and full Couple accounts manage only their confirmed booking's groups and
households. A personalized link can read/respond only for its household and cannot
discover another household. Restricted prospects, Staff (except provider-mediated
operations read), generic QR holders, and public users cannot manage guest data.

Specified resources are `/bookings/{bookingId}/guest-groups`,
`/bookings/{bookingId}/households`, personalized invitation/RSVP routes, and Manager
import/export actions. Imports validate every row before commit and report row-safe
errors without exposing unrelated data. Mutations use expected revision and
`Idempotency-Key`; errors include `GUEST_GROUP_NAME_CONFLICT`,
`GUEST_GROUP_IN_USE`, `RSVP_REVISION_STALE`, and concealed
`HOUSEHOLD_NOT_FOUND`.

## 6. Acceptance

Test default-group creation, normalized uniqueness, archival, positive counts, import
atomicity, link isolation, PII redaction, duplicated/out-of-order RSVP events, expected
total update, and the headcount-to-seating invalidation flow with the real booking
provider. Prove QRC-005: generic QR and personalized invitation tokens are technically
distinct and non-interchangeable.

## 7. Attendance formula, revision ordering, and lifecycle decisions

A household keeps a positive `expectedAttendees` count (1–100) used by staff as the
invited party expectation. RSVP status is `PENDING | ACCEPTED | DECLINED`; accepted
response records a positive `respondingAttendees` count (1–100). Companion names are
not collected. Planned contribution is expected count for PENDING, responding count for
ACCEPTED, zero for DECLINED or archived household. Booking planningHeadcount is the sum
of these contributions, not the sum of invitations regardless of RSVP.

Every contribution-changing create/import/update/archive/RSVP creates one immutable
booking-wide attendance-plan revision and increases `sourceSequence`; atomic import
creates one aggregate revision for the batch. Group rename/color-only edit need not
increase headcount sequence but increments its own/reporting sequence. An empty guest
list has total zero and an initialized immutable aggregate revision; reports never
invent a household for it.

Default groups are created idempotently when guest workspace is first initialized after
confirmation, not by mutating guest tables from Booking. Group name 1–80, normalized
NFKC/trim/case-fold for uniqueness; color is uppercase `#RRGGBB`. Archived group IDs
remain resolvable; they cannot be selected for new households/labels. Household name
1–120, phone optional normalized E.164, note 0–500. Group deletion is archival only;
renaming does not rewrite historical snapshots.

Additive owner ports are `GuestAttendancePlanReader`,
`GuestOperationsSearchReader`, `GuestAutomationReader`, and
`GuestReportingReader`. Publish exact DTOs plus fake/real conformance tests before
Staff/Seating/Analytics consumes them. Staff facade authorizes assignment first;
guest search enforces matching booking scope, active household visibility, 1–50 page
size, and only returned phoneLast4. Internal exact operations reader remains minimum data.

## 8. Personalized-link and RSVP security contract

Link tokens contain at least 32 random bytes, are stored hashed, and bind one booking/
household plus token revision/expiry. Initial expiry is event end + 24 hours; reissue
revokes the old token atomically. A revoked/expired token returns generic
`INVITATION_LINK_UNAVAILABLE` without household details. Token is delivered in URL
fragment, exchanged for scoped in-memory capability, and removed from browser history.
No token enters logs, event outbox, public QR, or analytics.

One scoped capability authorizes only that household's minimal invitation view and RSVP.
It cannot read phone, note, groups list, billing, media library, or another household.
Mutation accepts status and attendee count plus current household revision, never booking
ID/group ownership as authority. Rate limit: 10 link exchanges or RSVP writes per
15 minutes per resolved IP plus token fingerprint; no permanent household lockout.

RSVP deadline defaults to event start − seven days and is snapshotted with
`deadlineRevision`. Manager may set an explicit audited deadline before opening link
delivery. After deadline, guest writes return `RSVP_DEADLINE_PASSED`; Manager/Couple
can correct their own household plan with audit, producing a new source sequence.
Guest views remain readable until link expiry. Early-created bookings whose event is
less than seven days away require an explicit Manager deadline before links are issued.

## 9. HTTP, import, delivery, and search hand-off

| Method/path                                                           | Input                                                                           | Output/authority                                                                                          |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET/POST /bookings/{id}/guest-groups                                  | List or name/color                                                              | Stable group DTO/revision; own FULL or Manager.                                                           |
| PATCH /bookings/{id}/guest-groups/{groupId}                           | expectedRevision, name?/color?/archive command                                  | Preserve stable ID and reference history.                                                                 |
| GET/POST /bookings/{id}/households                                    | Cursor/filter or representativeName/groupId/expectedAttendees/phone?/note?      | Own FULL/Manager DTO; PII stays private.                                                                  |
| PATCH /bookings/{id}/households/{householdId}                         | expectedRevision, approved partial fields                                       | New household revision/aggregate attendance plan when contribution changes.                               |
| POST /bookings/{id}/households/imports                                | Up to 1,000 validated JSON rows or parsed CSV equivalent, stable externalRowKey | Atomic preview/commit; same row key never inserts duplicate.                                              |
| POST /bookings/{id}/households/{householdId}/personalized-invitations | expectedRevision, delivery mode                                                 | Stable invitation identity and explicit authorized share link; token excluded from durable response logs. |
| POST /guest/invitation-sessions                                       | fragment token in strict body                                                   | Scoped in-memory capability; redacted route logging.                                                      |
| GET /guest/invitation                                                 | capability                                                                      | Approved public presentation plus minimal own RSVP status/count.                                          |
| POST /guest/rsvp                                                      | expectedRevision, status, respondingAttendees for ACCEPTED                      | New immutable RSVP plus planning contribution; no generic QR authority.                                   |

Import preview returns normalized row indexes/errors and proposed count; commit must use
the exact digest of that preview so edited data cannot bypass validation. Max 10,000
active households/booking; body/file limit 5 MiB; CSV header allowlist, spreadsheet
formula cells rejected, no partial writes. A duplicate row key with changed data requires
an explicit update preview, not blind overwrite.

Personalized sending owns delivery intent; actual provider delivery is delegated through
an invitation-delivery adapter supplied by Notifications with short-lived credential
handling as described in that SPEC. Until that adapter is ready, manual authorized
share links work and automated-delivery acceptance remains incomplete.

Search matching normalizes Unicode/case/diacritics for names and normalized full phone
for lookup. Rank exact name, prefix, substring, then household ID; name minimum two
characters, at least one of name/phone. Duplicate names remain separate ID-based rows;
never auto-check-in the first result. Search returns group display/phoneLast4/expected/
safe note; Staff joins actual attendance via its own ledger reader.

## 10. Durable headcount integration and parallel slices

At real integration, guest changes, RSVP/plan revisions, booking `synchronize`, reporting
sequence, audit, and outbox commit atomically in the shared booking unit-of-work.
A provider failure rolls back activation of the new guest plan. A staged recovery intent
may return `503 HEADCOUNT_SYNC_PENDING`, but is not a successful completed mutation;
replay activates guest and booking changes together. Retrying sequence 10 after 11 returns stale
acknowledgement; same-sequence altered count conflicts. `getExpectedAttendance`
remains the baseline port; ordered consumers use `GuestAttendancePlanReader.getPlan`.
RSVP decline changes planning contribution without mutating the original positive
household expectation or any actual arrivals. Archive cannot erase attendance history.

| Slice                                       | May overlap                      | Real dependency                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Groups/households/import and RSVP domain    | Invitation studio implementation | Reviewed publication and headcount contracts/fakes.                       |
| Personalized-link security/scoped UI        | Invitation public screens        | Real publication reader for published content, backend access tests.      |
| Headcount synchronization/operations search | Booking/Staff isolated work      | Real ordered booking port and Staff assignment facade before integration. |
| Delivery adapter                            | Notifications channel work       | Real recipient/link intent handling before automated-delivery acceptance. |

Proposed waves: groups/households/import; personalized credentials/RSVP;
ordered headcount/search/reporting ports; HTTP/OpenAPI; Couple/Guest clients; acceptance.

| Requirements     | Proof                                                                                                 |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GST-001–003      | One party/record, positive expectation, companions unnamed; decline contributes zero.                 |
| GST-004–007      | Idempotent defaults, normalization, stable IDs/color, archival/history/remap integrity.               |
| GST-008; QRC-005 | Token scope/revoke/expiry, independent generic/personalized links and authorized delivery.            |
| Shared contracts | Empty total, import atomicity, sequence 11 then 10, same sequence conflict, search booking isolation. |

The aggregate planning total is bounded 0–10,000; a mutation/import exceeding that
bound is rejected before commit. Optional recipientEmail is normalized/validated and
used only for explicitly requested personalized email delivery. It is not public output.
````
